$description: RecipeBox semantic design tokens: the Modern Cookbook identity (ADR 0018), one token set with a light and a dark value (ADR 0019). Source of truth for the native app. Components use token names only, never raw values.

canvas.role: App background. Warm off-white / warm near-black. Never #FFFFFF or #000000.

surface.role: Cards, grouped lists, recipe sheet over the hero photo.

surfaceRaised.role: Sheets, menus and anything above a surface. In dark, elevation is shown by a lighter surface, not a heavier shadow.

sunken.role: Wells: search field, steppers, progress tracks.

material.role: Translucent navigation and tab bars over scrolling content (with blur).

text.role: Primary text. Charcoal / warm ivory. Never pure black on pure white.

textTertiary.role: Captions, eyebrows, placeholder text, inactive tab labels.

separator.role: Hairlines between ingredient rows and steps.

separatorStrong.role: Section rules, list separators, control outlines.

accent.role: Primary button fill, selected states, progress fill (light). Botanical green / deeper sage-green fill.

onAccent.role: Text and icons on an accent fill.

accentText.role: Links, active tab, tinted icons, progress fill (dark). Sage green in dark.

attention.role: Needs-review text and icon (import flags, unresolved quantities). Always paired with an icon and a word.

tileGround.role: Typographic tile for a recipe without a photo.

tileInk.role: Initial and category on the typographic tile.

onPhoto.role: Icons and status text placed over photography. Only ever on top of photoOverlay or a photoControl disc.

photoControl.role: Blurred disc behind a control that floats on a photo (back, favourite, more).

photoOverlayTop.role: Top-edge gradient (to transparent over 120pt) behind the status bar and floating controls on a hero photo. The only overlay applied to photos; photos are never dimmed as a whole.

contrast.$description: Pairs that must meet the minimum ratio in BOTH appearances. Checked by scripts/design-tokens-check.js.

typography.$description: Sizes are iOS points / Android sp at the default text size. All roles scale with the OS text setting (Dynamic Type / font scale). Serif = Newsreader bundled with expo-font. Sans = the platform system font (SF Pro on iOS, Roboto on Android). Line heights are absolute at 100% and scale with size.

sans.note: Never bundle a sans; the system face carries Dynamic Type metrics, legibility tuning and localisation.

largeTitle.use: Screen titles (Good evening, Recipes, Review import).

cardTitle.use: Recipe titles on cards and list rows.

body.use: Method steps on Recipe Detail, ingredient names, paragraphs.

cookStep.use: The instruction in Cook Mode. System sans for legibility at arm's length (approved 2026-11-08).

tabLabel.use: Tab bar labels. Do not scale; iOS shows the Large Content Viewer on long-press instead.

scaling.rule: Every role except tabLabel scales without a cap up to 200%. Layout changes at 1.35× and above (see design spec), never truncation.

elevation.$description: Light: soft, warm shadows. Dark: shadows deepen but elevation is mainly carried by a lighter surface plus a 1pt top highlight (inset rgba(255,250,240,0.045)). Android maps level to `elevation`.

2.use: Cards, recipe photos, primary docked button.

3.use: Sheets and the recipe sheet rising over its hero.

motion.reducedMotion: When Reduce Motion is on: screen pushes become cross-fades, sheets appear without the rise, step changes in Cook Mode do not slide, and no element animates position. Haptics are unaffected.

photography.overlayPolicy: Photos keep their natural colour and brightness in both appearances. The only overlay is photoOverlayTop, applied where status bar or controls sit on a hero photo. Text is never set directly on a photo.
